passages.title: Michael in the stranded van
passages.content: Thanks to the angle of the van and the injuries Michael had sustained, just opening a door and clambering out of the vehicle seemed an insurmountable challenge, never mind climbing up 145 feet of steep, rugged terrain. He'd have to rely on being rescued. But that wouldn't be easy. Michael could hear cars whizzing past on the road above, but even if passersby happened to glimpse his vehicle amid the shoulder-high brush, apparently abandoned, they wouldn't be able to see anyone inside. He had no cellphones-Michael had never seen the point of getting one. No one knew he'd had taken an unplanned drive out of Victoria, so they'd have no reason to look for him here. And he couldn't honk to get the attention of drivers on the highway. In the 19years that he'd owned his van, the horn had never worked. On the plus side, he was dry, at least for the most part. It was cold in the van, but he had an extra fleece-ironically, emblazoned with 'Live the adventure, live the dream." To sustain himself, he had scattered roasted veggies, the bread which was now inedible, but he had a bag of mini chocolate bars. To drink he had one water bottle. He apportioned out his stash and switched on his hazard lights, hoping someone would spot him from the highway above. It was a false hope. He didn't realize that his off road descent had ripped the wires off the van's undercarriage.

passages.title: Indian nutrition guidelines
passages.content: The INTERNET is flooded with wisdom on nutrition, be it weight-loss diets, intermittent fasting, veganism, giving up carbohydrates or taking supplements. The truth is, it is difficult to find a balanced meal that works for you from the information swirling around you. That's why the National Institute of Nutrition (NIN), under the aegis of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), has released a comprehensive guideline on how Indians should be eating clean with easily accessible resources and, most importantly, what suits their body type. Complete with an ideal plate, diet charts, recipes and advisories on how you should be cooking and in what cookware, this is an essential handbook that all of us would find convenient to incorporate into our daily lives. Given India's growing burden of non- communicable diseases, these guidelines are significant as they lay down the template of foundational nutrition in children, beginning with pregnant women. The report says that proper nutrition for a mother and child is linked not only to proper growth and development but also to the risk of diabetes, hypertension and heart attack later in life. Over 56 percent of all non-communicable diseases can be attributed to an unhealthy diet. As the reports show, a healthy diet can prevent 80 percent of type 2 diabetes and significantly reduce the burden of heart disease, high blood pressure and prevent premature deaths. It has even warned against taking supplements for building body mass and recommended restricting salt intake, minimizing sugar and ultra-processed foods and reading information on food labels correctly.

passages.title: Indian Writing in English
passages.content: The seed of Indian Writing in English was sown during the period of the British rule in India. Now the seed has blossomed into an evergreen tree, with fragrant flowers and ripe fruits. The fruits are being tasted not only by the native people, but they are also being 'chewed and digested' by the foreigners. It happened only after constant care, pruning and feeding. Indian English Literature is an honest enterprise to demonstrate the ever rare gems of Indian Writing in English. From being a singular and exceptional, rather gradual native flare - up of geniuses, Indian Writing has turned out to be a new form of Indian culture and voice in which India converses regularly. Indian writers - poets, novelists, essayists, and dramatists have been making momentous and considerable contributions to world literature since the Pre - Independence era. The past few years have witnessed a gigantic prospering and thriving of Indian English Writing in the global market. Indian English Literature has attained an independent status in the realm of world literature. Wide ranges of themes are dealt with by Indian writing in English. While this literature continues to reflect Indian culture, tradition, social values and even Indian history through the depiction of life in India and Indians living elsewhere, recent Indian English fiction has been trying to give expression to the Indian experience of modern predicaments.

The passage states that even if passersby happened to glimpse the vehicle, it was amid "shoulder-high
brush," which means the high foliage was the direct obstruction preventing them from spotting the van
easily or seeing Michael inside.

questions.questionText: 'He apportioned out his stash..', what does the word stash as mentioned in the passage refer to:-
questions.solution:
Stash (as a noun, which is how it's used in the sentence "He apportioned out his stash...") means a secret
store or hidden supply of something.

In the context of the passage, Michael's "stash" refers to his hidden supply of food and drink.

questions.questionText: The slogan on the soft blanket was ironical as _____.

options.text: he was living the adventure in reality.
options.sourceText: he was living the adventure in reality.

options.text: he had always dreamed of being in an accident.
options.sourceText: he had always dreamed of being in an accident.

options.text: he was confronting a near-fatal situation.
options.sourceText: he was confronting a near-fatal situation.

questions.solution:
"Live the adventure, live the dream" is a slogan that suggests excitement, happiness, and a highly
desirable, positive experience.
The Reality (The Irony): Michael is injured, trapped in an angled van, in a difficult location, with no
way to call for help, facing an "insurmountable challenge" just to get out, and confronting a situation
that is potentially fatal. This is the opposite of a desirable "adventure" or "dream."

questions.questionText: The guidelines on how Indians should eat were released because:-

options.text: NIN was flooded with requests from people for some guidelines.
options.sourceText: NIN was flooded with requests from people for some guidelines.

options.text: It was becoming difficult to find a balanced meal from the information available.
options.sourceText: It was becoming difficult to find a balanced meal from the information available.

options.text: ICMR pressured NIN to release the guidelines on what people should eat.
options.sourceText: ICMR pressured NIN to release the guidelines on what people should eat.

options.text: ICMR wanted to take over the responsibility for the health of an average Indian.
options.sourceText: ICMR wanted to take over the responsibility for the health of an average Indian.

questions.solution:
The passage clearly states that the internet is "flooded with wisdom on nutrition," but that this information
makes it "difficult to find a balanced meal that works for you." The National Institute of Nutrition (NIN)
released the guidelines specifically to give people a "comprehensive" and clear handbook on healthy eating
to reduce this confusion and solve the information overload problem.

questions.questionText: Identify the word closest in meaning to the word aegis as used in the passage:-
questions.solution:
In the phrase, "under the aegis of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)," aegis means support,
sponsorship, or protection. It clarifies that the National Institute of Nutrition (NIN) released the guidelines
with the official backing and authority of the ICMR, which is the main medical research body in India.

questions.questionText: NIN recommends reading the information on labels correctly as:-

options.text: People's knowledge of nutritional facts will increase.
options.sourceText: People's knowledge of nutritional facts will increase.

options.text: The marketing strategy of manufacturers goes hand in hand with the NIN guidelines.
options.sourceText: The marketing strategy of manufacturers goes hand in hand with the NIN guidelines.

options.sourceText: The endorsement by the celebrities makes the product more salable.

options.sourceText: The claims made by manufacturers about the product can be deceptive.

questions.solution:
NIN recommends reading labels because the claims made by manufacturers about the product can be
deceptive. This ensures consumers can look past marketing and know the actual ingredients to make healthy
choices

questions.questionText: The guidelines on how Indians should eat issued by NIN are important as:-

options.text: They lay down the structure of the basic nutrition needs of an average Indian.
options.sourceText: They lay down the structure of the basic nutrition needs of an average Indian.

options.sourceText: They provide guidance on how to live our lives.

The passage emphasizes the significance of the guidelines because of "India's growing burden of non-

can prevent 80% of type 2 diabetes and significantly reduce the burden of heart disease, highlighting their
primary goal is disease prevention.
questions.dataQualityNote: Printed answer key says A (choice 1), but the solution says disease prevention is the primary goal, which aligns with choice 2. Source conflict; answer not silently changed.

questions.solution:

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate word or phrase to complete the
following sentence:-

Once you ___into the routine, you will find the work is quite easy.
questions.solution:
When a sentence uses a future result ("you will find...") and starts with a time conjunction like
"Once" (or if, when, as soon as), the verb in the "Once" clause must be in the Simple Present tense.
"are settled" is the grammatically correct Simple Present (in the passive voice) needed here. The other
options are incorrect tenses (past perfect, simple past, simple future).
